svg.title: Sev Geraskin: PolarGrid's live and planned sites, with requests flying to the nearest live site
svg.desc: A dark dot map of the world. Eight live PolarGrid sites in North America glow pink: Seattle, San Jose, Los Angeles, Dallas, Miami, Ashburn, New York and Montreal. Thirty-five planned sites on five continents are dashed rings. Requests from North American cities fly along arcs to the nearest live site.
svg.text: AI has to answer as fast as a person would. So the computer has to sit near the person.
A request served from the nearest live site
